system.summary: 700-entry table of numbered words, place and ship names, syllables and single letters (1757 Vaudreuil table), with names and titles left in clear and phonetic spelling.
system.sibling_key: Key found for catalogue 1391 (vaudreuil1760): the 1757 Vaudreuil table ANOM COL C11E 10 f.289 (LAC e001295274); it fits this letter from the first line.
system.notes: Table in numerical order only on the sheet used (the alphabetical sheets e001295267/69 give the same entries by word).

conditions.human_role: Asked for the sibling letters of catalogue 1391 to be decoded and then made into targets of their own.

solution.what: Table found for catalogue 1391 (same hand, same office, months apart) tried on this letter: function words fall in place.
Images fetched from the LAC image server with curl -L (about half the requests need a retry).

Decoded with the table and its context-corrected cells (key/overrides.json); 12 groups sit on a cell still doubtful and 0 are cut at the gutter; the decode reads as French throughout but no reader has reviewed it as sentences.

Written ordinals 1o-4o (f.54-) are figures, not cipher groups: bracketed in transcription.txt and removed from ct.txt (the decode had read them as cell 1 etc.). Overrides synchronised with cat. 1391 (cell 2 = campagne).

outcome.method: read after matching with key from external sources
outcome.method_basis: The 1757 Vaudreuil table (ANOM COL C11E 10, LAC e001295274), found to fit catalogue 1391 of the same hand, applied to this letter.

texts.label: ANOM, COL C11A 104, ff.54-66 (CABAC_PIAF_60891)
texts.summary: Vaudreuil reports to the minister on the winter and the defence plan: famine and loss of draught animals, a British army of about 20-25 000 against Niagara, Fort Duquesne evacuated, Montcalm's absence, and numbered requests for battalions, munitions and provisions.

outcome.notes: Decoded, not read: the whole letter decodes mechanically as French with the 1757 table (99.7% of groups carry a settled table value), but the decode, in the clerk's syllabic spelling, has not been reviewed as sentences or translated. Mechanical decode with the syllabic spelling left as written; no English translation and no reader review yet. The table cells were read from the images of the volume by the same model.
